Plot cohort-style score correlations

Source: R/04_anomaly_correlations.R
plot_correlations.Rd

Returns a named list of two plots visualising year-to-year cohort Spearman correlations by grade-pair within each subject.

Usage

plot_correlations(correlation_table, assessment_spec)

Arguments

correlation_table

Data frame returned by compute_correlations().

assessment_spec

Named list describing the assessment program (used for subject labels).

Value

A named list with elements $line (line plot over time, one line per grade-pair) and $heatmap (correlation heatmap by grade-pair and year-pair), each a ggplot object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
tbl <- compute_correlations(demo_data, assessment_spec)
plots <- plot_correlations(tbl, assessment_spec)
plots$line
} # }
